segments.title: Cold Open & Pepito Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the station sign-on as executive producer dog; Kendall walks through with signature theme music.

segments.title: Pre-Show Chat & Sub Goal Shopping
segments.notes: Case and Pepito discuss Boston weather, Planet Fitness deal, papal conclave stream idea, yellow tie rebellion sub goal (buys fish tie instead), Hamtaro kigurumi onesie search, workout stream sub goal.

segments.title: Papal Conclave & Trump Budget with Jeff Ripple
segments.notes: Jeff Ripple joins; papal conclave history and 2025 contenders (including Jelly Roll); Trump's $163B budget proposal cutting education, NIH, CDC, IRS while boosting homeland security 65%.

segments.title: Family Guy Porn Debate
segments.notes: Crum owes Rock-afire gorilla $125k; Munch forces Crum to defend 'good videos vs Family Guy porn' in Amongst the Web; Crum wins $5k by arguing for aged-up adult fan erotica.

segments.title: Viewer Submissions & Ayahuasca Vision
segments.notes: Case and Jeff review clips: lawyer commercial, 90s dance workout, gym proposal, Wendy's AI drive-thru, Bee Movie meme; Case claims ayahuasca vision of cloud coyote.

segments.title: Liliana News Desk: Screwworms & Overwatch
segments.notes: Liliana joins; Northumberland arsonist, New World screwworm invasion (USDA carpet-bombing Mexico with sterile flies), Overwatch 6v6 perk update, Keanu Reeves/Sandra Bullock reunion film, WWE releases.

segments.title: Kendall Visit: Envato & Influencer Manager Bit
segments.notes: Kendall appears, logs into Envato on Case's PC, peels self-portraits onto his monitor, declares herself 'influencer manager' not 'content pimp', discusses dinner plans and New York Chinese food.

segments.title: Rapid-Fire News: Renner, Kentucky Derby, AI Radio, Zipper Tech
segments.notes: Jeremy Renner turned down Hawkeye S2 over half-salary offer citing snowmobile accident; Kentucky Derby Uma Musume crossover; Australian radio ARN used AI host 'Thy' 6 months undisclosed; self-zipping zipper demo; Paresh Rawal drinks urine.

segments.title: Chris Sawyer Interview: RollerCoaster Tycoon Creator
segments.notes: Chris Sawyer (RollerCoaster Tycoon/Transport Tycoon creator) appears; defends 90s PC optimization, hates Planet Coaster, consults for Frontier, retired from game dev, last original title Locomotion.

segments.title: Trip Bradstein: Park Opinions & Chris Sawyer Returns
segments.notes: Trip in park interviews: Family Guy porn enjoyer (Cleveland/Lois), Chris Sawyer returns twice more (RCT3 regrets, reads Case's article), Darfus the rat, Hamtaro cultist, bird trainer, rollercoaster guy, park ranger suggests Family Guy porn for Chris Sawyer.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid
segments.notes: Case wraps, thanks mods, teases Monday stream, papal conclave stream, Hamtaro stream, Antara stream; raids Static Slater.

Claims 'super strength in spits'; demonstrated crushing electric toothbrush into dust on air.
Keeping shape-shifting rat named Darfus in studio walls; rat affects minds; possibly conducting interdimensional demonic practices.
Retired from full-time game development; last original title was Locomotion; consulted on RCT3; has working relationship with Frontier (Planet Coaster devs).

episode_summary: Case Blackwell anchored a marathon broadcast featuring a papal conclave preview, Trump budget analysis with Jeff Ripple, and a Munch & Crum debate where Crum defended aged-up Family Guy fan erotica to win $5k toward his $125k Rock-afire gorilla debt. Liliana co-anchored a news block covering the New World screwworm invasion and Overwatch's revival, while Kendall returned for an extended bit as 'influencer manager.' The show interviewed RollerCoaster Tycoon creator Chris Sawyer, who attacked Planet Coaster and revealed his retirement, then handed off to Trip Bradstein in the park for a chaotic string of interviews including a returning Chris Sawyer, a rat named Darfus, and a park ranger suggesting Family Guy porn as conflict resolution. Case closed by teasing a papal conclave stream, Hamtaro event, and Monday return.
